output: html_document
params:
  rxn1_outs: "inputs/ivy_rxn1/outs"
  rxn2_outs: "inputs/ivy_rxn2/outs"
  annotation_gff: "inputs/cj1700.gff"
  tss_bed: "tss.bed"
  output_rds: "results/merged_SN_ivy.rds"
---

This notebook prepares and integrates the RNA and ATAC profiles from two
10x Multiome reactions from one marmoset ventral midbrain specimen.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(Signac)
library(Seurat)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(GenomeInfoDb)
library(S4Vectors)

outs_list <- c(ivy1 = params$rxn1_outs, ivy2 = params$rxn2_outs)
arc_files <- c(
  "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5",
  "atac_peaks.bed",
  "atac_fragments.tsv.gz",
  "atac_fragments.tsv.gz.tbi"
)
required_files <- c(
  params$annotation_gff, params$tss_bed,
  unlist(lapply(outs_list, file.path, arc_files), use.names = FALSE)
)
missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Missing inputs:\n", paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"), call. = FALSE)
}
```

## Reference annotation

```{r annotation}
#get annotation
#Use marmoset NCBI GFF for gene annotation since it contains gene_biotype

annotation <- rtracklayer::import(params$annotation_gff, format = "gff3")
meta_GR = mcols(annotation)
mcols(annotation) <- NULL
mcols(annotation) <- cbind( meta_GR, DataFrame(
  tx_id = meta_GR$transcript_id,
  gene_name = meta_GR$Name,
  gene_id = meta_GR$gene
))
##rename gene annotation chromosome names: change dash and colons to dots
newnames = seqlevels(annotation)
newnames = gsub("_", ".", newnames)
newnames = gsub(":", ".", newnames)
newnames = gsub("-", ".", newnames)
names(newnames) = seqlevels(annotation)
annotation = renameSeqlevels(annotation, newnames)
cat(sprintf("Done creating annotation GR ranges object\n"))

#load in tss bed
tss <- rtracklayer::import(params$tss_bed, format = "bed")

```


#helper functions to process each multiome reaction
```{r}
# Build an RNA-only Seurat object from a 10x Multiome outs/ folder
create_rna_object <- function(outs, name = "") {
  counts <- Read10X_h5(file.path(outs, "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5"))
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = counts$`Gene Expression`, assay = "RNA")
  cat(sprintf("Done creating Seurat object %s: %dx%d\n", name, nrow(obj[["RNA"]]), ncol(obj[["RNA"]])))
  obj
}

# RNA QC: drop low-count nuclei, then remove doublets with scDblFinder
filter_rna_qc <- function(obj, min_nCount_RNA = 1000) {
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = nCount_RNA > min_nCount_RNA)
  doub <- scDblFinder::scDblFinder(obj[["RNA"]]$counts, verbose = TRUE)
  obj <- AddMetaData(obj, as.data.frame(SummarizedExperiment::colData(doub)))
  subset(obj, subset = (scDblFinder.class == "singlet"))
}

# Read the cellranger-arc peak bed of one reaction as GRanges
read_peaks_bed <- function(outs) {
  peaks <- read.table(file.path(outs, "atac_peaks.bed"), col.names = c("chr", "start", "end"))
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(peaks)
}

# Unified peak set across reactions.
# disjoin slices peaks so that every peak appearing in each rxn can still be represented
build_combined_peaks <- function(outs_list, min_width = 20, max_width = 10000) {
  combined <- disjoin(do.call(c, unname(lapply(outs_list, read_peaks_bed))))
  w <- width(combined)
  combined <- combined[w < max_width & w > min_width]
  #filter out irregular chromosomes (starting with chrUn or ending with random)
  keepStandardChromosomes(combined, pruning.mode = "tidy")
}

# Quantify the unified peaks, add the ATAC assay, run ATAC QC and normalize both assays
add_peaks_assay <- function(obj, outs, peaks, annotation, tss = NULL,
                            min_nCount_peaks = 1000, max_nCount_peaks = 100000,
                            max_nucleosome_signal = 2) {
  frag <- CreateFragmentObject(
    path = file.path(outs, "atac_fragments.tsv.gz"),
    cells = colnames(obj)
  )
  peak_counts <- FeatureMatrix(fragments = frag, features = peaks, cells = colnames(obj))
  obj[["peaks"]] <- CreateChromatinAssay(peak_counts, fragments = frag, annotation = annotation)

  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "peaks"
  if (!is.null(tss)) obj <- TSSEnrichment(obj, tss.positions = tss)
  obj <- NucleosomeSignal(obj)
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = nCount_peaks < max_nCount_peaks &
                  nCount_peaks > min_nCount_peaks &
                  nucleosome_signal < max_nucleosome_signal)

  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
  obj <- NormalizeData(obj)
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "peaks"
  NormalizeData(obj)
}
```

#first create Seurat objects based on RNAseq data and run RNA QC
```{r}
ivy_list <- Map(create_rna_object, outs_list, names(outs_list))

#use RNA counts to QC
hist(ivy_list$ivy1@meta.data[["nCount_RNA"]], main = "Histogram of nCount_RNA", xlab = "nCount_RNA", xlim = c(0, 40000), breaks = 10000)

ivy_list <- lapply(ivy_list, filter_rna_qc)
```

#unify the ATAC peaks, then add peak assays, QC and normalize each dataset
```{r}
combined.peaks <- build_combined_peaks(outs_list)
combined.peaks

ivy_list <- Map(add_peaks_assay, ivy_list, outs_list,
                MoreArgs = list(peaks = combined.peaks, annotation = annotation, tss = tss))

#use peaks data to inspect QC
hist(ivy_list$ivy1@meta.data[["nucleosome_signal"]], main = "Histogram of nucleosome_signal", xlab = "nucleosome_signal", xlim = c(0, 3), breaks = 10000)
```

#merge
```{r}
for (nm in names(ivy_list)) ivy_list[[nm]]$dataset <- nm

# Merge the two reactions and preserve their original cell ID prefixes.
SN.ivy <- merge(ivy_list$ivy1, ivy_list$ivy2, add.cell.ids = c("1", "2"))
```



```{r}
DefaultAssay(SN.ivy) <- "RNA"
SN.ivy <- SCTransform(SN.ivy)
SN.ivy <- RunPCA(SN.ivy)
DefaultAssay(SN.ivy) <- "peaks"
SN.ivy <- FindTopFeatures(SN.ivy, min.cutoff = 5)
SN.ivy <- RunTFIDF(SN.ivy)
SN.ivy <- RunSVD(SN.ivy)

#visualize in UMAP
#try joint UMAP (RNA+ATAC)
SN.ivy <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(
  object = SN.ivy,
  reduction.list = list("pca", "lsi"),
  dims.list = list(1:50, 2:40),
  modality.weight.name = "RNA.weight",
  verbose = TRUE
)
SN.ivy <- FindClusters(object = SN.ivy, verbose = TRUE, algorithm = 3, resolution = 0.5, graph.name = "wsnn")
SN.ivy <- RunUMAP(
  object = SN.ivy,
  nn.name = "weighted.nn",
  assay = "RNA",
  verbose = TRUE
)
DimPlot(SN.ivy, label = TRUE, repel = TRUE, group.by = "wsnn_res.0.5", reduction = "umap") + NoLegend()

DimPlot(SN.ivy, group.by = "dataset", label = TRUE, reduction = "umap")
dir.create(dirname(params$output_rds), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
saveRDS(SN.ivy, file = params$output_rds)
```
